grammar.definition:
BudgetIslands:
    Root <- [a-z]+ eoi
    Mixed <- Root Act
    Act <- '!' {dummyAction}

rootCauses.detail: Direct lowered loops consume 4 steps while combinator tree fallback consumes 11 steps for 'abc'. Bypassing the guard causes direct mode to succeed at stepLimit=4 while tree fallback fails with resourceLimit.
Direct mode is @nogc with 0 arena allocations; treeFallback allocates ParseTree nodes and strings. Low memory limits fail in treeFallback but succeed in direct mode.
Direct mode inlines character loops without intermediate combinator trace calls; treeFallback fires trace callbacks for every combinator.
In records mode, treeFallback performs an extra recursive projectRecords tree traversal, consuming additional steps and recursion depth.

performanceSummary.guardedOffRatio: 1.75-1.79x on 16-byte Identifier due to pre-fallback condition evaluation overhead
